solutions.title: Timestamp queue
solutions.strategy: Store one timestamp per hit and evict stale timestamps on query.

timeComplexity.explanation: A query may remove many stale hits.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Every hit in the active window can be stored.

solutions.title: Rolling buckets
solutions.strategy: Use 300 circular buckets keyed by timestamp modulo 300.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each query sums a fixed number of buckets.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The bucket arrays have fixed size.
